problem.statement_latex: Given uniform quantum examples of $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ with at most $k$ nonzero Fourier coefficients, recover $f$ exactly with constant success probability. The resource is copies of examples, with processing counted separately.
problem.statement_text: Given uniform quantum examples of $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ with at most $k$ nonzero Fourier coefficients, recover $f$ exactly with constant success probability. The resource is copies of examples, with processing counted separately.

hardware.description_latex: Each example occupies $n+1$ logical qubits. The algorithm additionally needs the indicated number of coherent examples and its measurement/postprocessing workspace; preparing these examples is part of the supplied-access model.
